title: Vanilla Plus by czqawa
description: Project: Minecraft datapack adding recipes, custom drops, and experience from mining blocks and harvesting crops, while also fixing and improving several game mechanics and loot tables.
body:
# Features
### **Crafting & Recipe Improvements**
    • Many new crafting recipes expanding survival possibilities
    • Optimized stonecutter recipes for multiple materials
    • Ability to process all wood types using the stonecutter
    • Smelting recipes adjustments
    • Blasting recipes for "smeling only" items
    • Recycling recipes allowing players to recover materials:
        ◦ metals
        ◦ wool
        ◦ sticks
        ◦ and many more
    • Compacting recipes for materials that normally cannot be compacted (for example ice,mushroom,clay, wool)
### **Custom Drop System (Core Feature)**
    • Many blocks in the game have custom drops tied to their environment
    • Depending on rarity drops grant experience when mined
    • Drops are based on dimension or structure, including:
        ◦ Nether
        ◦ End
        ◦ stone, dirt, sand layers
        ◦ strongholds
        ◦ bastions
        ◦ other world structures
    • The system is designed to add lore and it's a real archeology
    • Crops have a chance to grant experience when harvested
### Gameplay Improvements
    • Metal tools drop scrap materials when broken
    • Certain tools break specific blocks more efficiently
        ◦ pickaxes break glass faster
        ◦ axes break leaves faster
    • Copper blocks can be used as a beacon base
    • Changes to several vanilla loot tables, including:
        ◦ kelp
        ◦ vines
        ◦ nether wart blocks
        ◦ jungle leaves
        ◦ copper ore
        ◦ mushroom blocks
